test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

I said to him, “Please stay here tonight.”

options.text: I requested him to please stay there tonight.
I asked him if he would stay there that night.
I asked him to please stay here that night.
I requested him to stay there that night.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In indirect speech, the word **'please'** is omitted when converting a request.
 
• The pronoun '**here' **changes to **'there' **and **'tonight' **changes to **'that night'**.
 
• The verb '**said to**' changes to **'requested**' when making a polite request.

Hence, the correct statement is '***I requested him to stay there that night*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When changing direct speech to indirect speech, always pay attention to the **pronouns, verb tenses, and expressions of time and place.**
